```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = "../Figures/mod_orig/")

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(pROC)
library(yardstick)
library(glmnet)
library(rpart)
```

# Intro

```{r Caricamento dati, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_cleaned.Rdata")
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test.Rdata")

glimpse(dat_cleaned)
glimpse(dat_test)

dat_eval <- dat_test
rm(dat_test)
```

# GLM base

```{r GLM base}
library(tidymodels)
split <- initial_split(data=dat_cleaned, prop=4/5)
dat_cleaned <- training(split)
dat_test <- testing(split)

glm0 <- glm(goal_YN ~ goal_distance + shot_angle_degree, family=binomial, data=dat_cleaned)
summary(glm0)
exp(coef(glm0))

prob_glm0_test <- predict(glm0, newdata=dat_test,
                         type="response")
prob_glm0_eval <- predict(glm0, newdata=dat_eval,
                         type="response")
```

# Approccio forward

```{r GLM forward}
m0 <- glm(goal_YN~1, family=binomial, data=dat_cleaned)
summary(m0)
# Create formula for upper model

upper_formula <- formula(glm(goal_YN~(.), family=binomial, data=dat_cleaned))

# Stepwise selection
m1 <- stepAIC(m0, scope = list(lower = ~ 1, upper = upper_formula), direction = "forward", data = dat_cleaned)

# Summary of the final model
summary(m1)
anova(glm0, m1, test="Chisq")
anova(m0, m1, test="Chisq")
anova(m1, test="Chisq")
AIC(m0,m1, glm0)

prob_forward_test <- predict(m1, newdata=dat_test, type="response")
prob_forward_eval <- predict(m1, newdata=dat_eval, type="response")
```

# Ridge

```{r Ridge}
x_matrix <- model.matrix(~., data=dat_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(!"(Intercept)") %>% as.matrix()

ridge1 <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  y=dat_cleaned %>% pull(goal_YN),
  x=x_matrix,
  family="binomial",lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, nlambda=300,
  alpha=0, intercept=T, maxit = 1e+06,
                 nfolds = 5)

plot(ridge1) #grafico tra valore del coefficiente e penalità

x_matrix_test <- model.matrix(~.,dat_test%>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(!"(Intercept)") %>% as.matrix()

x_matrix_eval <- model.matrix(~.,dat_eval%>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(!"(Intercept)") %>% as.matrix()

ridge1$lambda.min
ridge1$lambda.1se

log(ridge1$lambda.min)
log(ridge1$lambda.1se)

coef(ridge1, s = ridge1$lambda.min)
coef(ridge1, s = ridge1$lambda.1se)

prob_ridge1_test <- predict(ridge1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = ridge1$lambda.min)
prob_ridge1_eval <- predict(ridge1,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = ridge1$lambda.min)

prob_lasso2_test <- predict(ridge1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = ridge1$lambda.1se)
prob_lasso2_eval <- predict(ridge1,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = ridge1$lambda.1se)
```


# Lasso

```{r Lasso}
lasso1 <- cv.glmnet(
  y=dat_cleaned %>% pull(goal_YN),
  x=x_matrix,
  family="binomial",lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, nlambda=300,
  alpha=1, maxit = 1e+07, nfolds = 5)

plot(lasso1) #grafico tra valore del coefficiente e penalità

lasso1$lambda.min
lasso1$lambda.1se

log(lasso1$lambda.min)
log(lasso1$lambda.1se)

coef(lasso1, s = lasso1$lambda.min)
coef(lasso1, s = lasso1$lambda.1se)

prob_lasso1_test <- predict(lasso1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = lasso1$lambda.min)
prob_lasso1_eval <- predict(lasso1,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = lasso1$lambda.min)

prob_lasso2_test <- predict(lasso1,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = lasso1$lambda.1se)
prob_lasso2_eval <- predict(lasso1,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = lasso1$lambda.1se)
```

## Grouped lasso

da sistemare

```{r Grouped Lasso, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
lasso_grp <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  y=dat_cleaned %>% pull(goal_YN),
  x=dat_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN),
  family="binomial",lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, nlambda=300,
  alpha=1, maxit = 1e+07,
  type.multinomial = "grouped", nfolds=5)

plot(lasso_grp) #grafico tra valore del coefficiente e penalità

lasso_grp$lambda.min
lasso_grp$lambda.1se

log(lasso_grp$lambda.min)
log(lasso_grp$lambda.1se)

coef(lasso_grp, s = lasso_grp$lambda.min)
coef(lasso_grp, s = lasso_grp$lambda.1se)

prob_lasso_grp_test <- predict(lasso_grp,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = lasso_grp$lambda.min)
prob_lasso_grp_eval <- predict(lasso_grp,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = lasso_grp$lambda.min)

prob_lasso2_test <- predict(lasso_grp,
        newx = x_matrix_test,
        s = lasso_grp$lambda.1se)
prob_lasso2_eval <- predict(lasso_grp,
                    newx = x_matrix_eval,
                    s = lasso_grp$lambda.1se)
```

# CART

```{r CART}
set.seed(456)
t0 <- rpart(goal_YN ~ ., data = dat_cleaned,
            method = "class",
            parms = list(split="gini"),
            control = rpart.control(minbucket = 5, cp = 0, xval=5))

set.seed(456)
t1 <- rpart(goal_YN ~ ., data = dat_cleaned,
            method = "class",
            parms = list(split="information"),
            control = rpart.control(minbucket = 5, cp = 0, xval=5))

plotcp(t0, main="t0")
plotcp(t1, main="t1")

t0_rowmin <- t0$cptable[,"xerror"] %>% which.min()
t1_rowmin <- t1$cptable[,"xerror"] %>% which.min()

t0_pruned <- prune(t0, cp=t0$cptable[t0_rowmin,"CP"])
t1_pruned <- prune(t1, cp=t1$cptable[t1_rowmin,"CP"])

prob_t0_test <- predict(t0, dat_test)[,2]
prob_t0p_test <- predict(t0_pruned, dat_test)[,2]
prob_t1_test <- predict(t1, dat_test)[,2]
prob_t1p_test <- predict(t1_pruned, dat_test)[,2]

prob_t0_eval <- predict(t0, dat_eval)[,2]
prob_t0p_eval <- predict(t0_pruned, dat_eval)[,2]
prob_t1_eval <- predict(t1, dat_eval)[,2]
prob_t1p_eval <- predict(t1_pruned, dat_eval)[,2]
```

# Valutazione: curva roc

```{r Valutazione, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
prediction <- tibble(truth = as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(prob_forward_eval),
                     model="GLM forward") %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN),
              model="GLM base",
              pred=as.numeric(prob_glm0)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN),
              model="Ridge",
              pred=as.numeric(ridge1_fitted)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN),
              model="Lasso1",
              pred=as.numeric(lasso1_fitted1)) %>%
              
              add_row( truth=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN),
              model="Lasso2",
              pred=as.numeric(lasso1_fitted2)) %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t0_predict), model="Tree gini") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t0p_predict), model="Tree gini (pruned)") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t1_predict), model="Tree entropy") %>%
  
  add_row(truth = as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN), pred=as.numeric(t1p_predict), model="Tree entropy (pruned)")

# Compute the ROC curves for each model
roc_data <- prediction %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, pred, event_level = "second")

auc_values <- prediction %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  yardstick::roc_auc(truth, pred, event_level = "second") %>%
  mutate(label_y = seq(0.01, 0.3, length.out = n())) %>%
  dplyr::select(!.estimator) %>% 
  rename(auc=.estimate)

# Merge the AUC values back into the ROC data for plotting
roc_data <- roc_data %>%
  left_join(auc_values, by = "model")

# Plot ROC curves with AUC annotations
ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "ROC Curves",
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  # Add AUC annotations
  geom_text(
    data = auc_values,
    aes(label = paste0("AUC = ", round(auc, 3)), y = label_y),
    x = 0.8,
    size = 4,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  coord_fixed()
```
Vedo che in entrambi i casi il modello ha previsto quasi esclusivamente 0, ossia non goal. Questo è dovuto anche alla grande presenza di 0 nel training set (90%).


# matrici di confusione

```{r Tabelle}
cm_and_fscore <- function(probs_test, prob_eval){
  
  library(pROC)
  my_roc <- roc(dat_test$goal_YN, probs_test)
  auc <- pROC::auc(my_roc)
  cat("AUC:", auc, "\n\n")
  soglia <- coords(my_roc, "best", ret = "threshold",
         best.method="closest.topleft",
         best.weights=c(1,mean(dat_test$goal_YN==1))) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("Soglia:", soglia, "\n\n")
  
  cat("\n-------------------------")
  Fitted_goal <-  ifelse(prob_eval >= soglia, 1, 0)
  
  f_score <- tibble(t=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN),
       e=factor(Fitted_goal, levels=c(0,1))) %>% f_meas(truth=t,
                  estimate=e, event_level = "second") %>% dplyr::select(.estimate) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("f-score:", f_score, "\n\n")
  
  caret::confusionMatrix(data=as.factor(Fitted_goal), reference=as.factor(dat_eval$goal_YN))
}

cm_and_fscore(prob_glm0_test, prob_glm0_eval)
cm_and_fscore(prob_forward_test, prob_forward_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_ridge1_test, prob_ridge1_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_lasso1_test, prob_lasso1_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_lasso1_test, prob_lasso1_test)
cm_and_fscore(prob_t0_test, prob_t0_eval)
cm_and_fscore(prob_t0p_test, prob_t0p_eval)
cm_and_fscore(prob_t1_test, prob_t1_eval)
cm_and_fscore(prob_t1p_test, prob_t1p_eval)
```
